items.title: OpenRouter 实测六模型并给出四层防护，解决 AI Agent 无限循环烧钱问题 / How to Stop an AI Agent Stuck in an Infinite Loop

sources.title: OpenRouter 实测六模型并给出四层防护，解决 AI Agent 无限循环烧钱问题 / How to Stop an AI Agent Stuck in an Infinite Loop
sources.title_zh: OpenRouter 实测六模型并给出四层防护，解决 AI Agent 无限循环烧钱问题
sources.title_en: How to Stop an AI Agent Stuck in an Infinite Loop
sources.title_original: How to Stop an AI Agent Stuck in an Infinite Loop
sources.summary: An AI agent gets stuck in an infinite loop when a model keeps calling a tool that fails, usually with the same arguments, because nothing in the agent loop tells it to stop. Each retry resends the whole conversation, so every turn costs more than the last, and a loop left running overnight can cost thousands of dollars.

sources.title_en: Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
sources.title_original: Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
sources.summary: 安全公司 Claroc 报告称，在检查的 37,571 个仍在线的 Grok 构建应用中，35,578 个（94.7%）无需登录即可访问，原因是发布对话框默认预选"Anyone with the link"，且每个应用的独立子域名会进入可检索的 passive DNS 数据库。

items.title: Runway 开源 27B 世界动作模型 Praxis-1，权重采用 Apache 2.0 许可 / Praxis-1 Is Now Available

sources.title: Runway 开源 27B 世界动作模型 Praxis-1，权重采用 Apache 2.0 许可 / Praxis-1 Is Now Available
sources.title_zh: Runway 开源 27B 世界动作模型 Praxis-1，权重采用 Apache 2.0 许可
sources.title_en: Praxis-1 Is Now Available
sources.title_original: Praxis-1 Is Now Available
sources.summary: Runway 宣布世界动作模型 Praxis-1 以 Apache 2.0 开放权重面向所有人开放。该模型为 27B 参数 MoE 扩散 Transformer，同时预测视频与动作，在 NVIDIA RoboLab-120 榜单以 46.2% 成功率居首，超过 FLUX 3 Action（42.9%）、Cosmos3 Nano（36.8%）和 π0.5（28.0%）。
